Name: Northern Zone
Description: Located in north Ethiopia, the Northern Zone is home to low grade Volcano-Sedimentary rocks, high grade Gneisses and Intrusives. This zone is particularly known for its rich deposits of Gold and Base Metals such as Copper, Coal, Marble, Granite and Iron.
